replacement_spec.body: Reification (also called concretism or hypostatization) is the logical and cognitive error of treating an abstract concept, relational pattern, or nominal category as if it were a concrete, independently existing thing. The process operates through language — grammaticalizing abstractions as subjects ('the market decided'), through institutional practice — incorporating corporations as legal 'persons,' and through folk psychology — treating 'human nature' as a causal force rather than a descriptive label. Parameters: (1) the target must be an abstraction — a category, relation, pattern, or nominal construct, not a naturally occurring entity, (2) the reification must attribute independent agency, essence, or material existence to the abstraction, (3) the error persists through cultural transmission — language habits, institutional reinforcement, and the cognitive convenience of treating relations as substances. The practice is self-correcting within disciplines that develop detection methods (Marx's commodity fetishism, Kant's transcendental illusion, legal personhood debates). [formal: reificatio | substrate: mind | horizon: a life | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.17]

PERSISTENCE: monetary convention — the issuer's guarantee, acceptance in trade, and the continuity of the mint's issue keep the stock circulating; individual coins wear out and are withdrawn, but the coinage endures while the convention of acceptance holds. replacement_spec.body: Amplification is the deliberate increase in the magnitude or intensity of a carried content, in two principal domains. (1) Physical: the increase in the amplitude or power of a signal by an active stage — parameters: an input signal, a gain factor (the ratio of output magnitude to input magnitude, reported linearly or in decibels), and a linear operating region bounded by a capacity limit beyond which the stage saturates; the mechanism is power conversion from a supply through active elements (valves, transistors, op-amps). (2) Rhetorical (auxesis): the strengthening of a claim or image by elaboration — parameters: a base claim, successive elaborations with repetition and intensification, and a cumulative effect that exceeds mere restatement. Persistence: the physical sense persists through circuit design standards, electronics and acoustics textbooks, and calibration practice; the rhetorical sense persists through rhetorical handbooks, the teaching of composition, and the literary tradition. replacement_spec.body: Error is the human-made concept that distinguishes an actual outcome from its expected, intended, or prescribed value. The construct operates by establishing a reference — a spec, a model, a test, a prior, a target — and then measuring the deviation of actual behavior from that reference. The error is the difference itself: what the system failed to match. It persists because it is the load-bearing unit of correction — quality control, debugging, verification, and every form of corrective reasoning are built around the act of detecting error and reducing it. The error can be measured against different kinds of reference, and each reference choice carves a different parameter: the gap between actual output and intended output, the gap between observed and predicted, the gap between current state and goal state.

replacement_spec.body: Learning is the human-made process by which a learner acquires durable knowledge, skill, or understanding through experience, study, or instruction, together with the organized channels — curriculum, apprenticeship, pedagogy, training regimen, evaluation — by which that process is conducted, transmitted, and verified. Its parameters: (1) the learner — the person or system undergoing change; (2) the channel — experience, deliberate practice, study, or instruction, and its organized form; (3) the durable change — the acquisition itself: a capability, skill, or understanding that persists beyond the exposure and is deployable on new cases; (4) the evidence — demonstrated retention, transfer, or performance that separates acquisition from mere exposure or recall. It persists as institution and practice: schools, curricula, and master-apprentice lineages on the human side; training pipelines, datasets, and evaluation protocols on the machine side — each generation's learning handed on through teaching. The natural acquisition within a single organism is described here as the practice's subject, never enrolled as the entry. Learning is not the visualization that plots its progress (that is the separate entry learning curve), not the stored product (memory), and not the repeated response itself (habit): it is the process that produces durable change, and its outputs are what persist. [formal: doctrina | substrate: mind|behavior | horizon: generations | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]

replacement_spec.body: Optimization is a human-made formal method of selecting values for a set of decision variables so as to maximize or minimize a specified objective function over a feasible region. Parameters: (1) the decision space — the variables and their domains; (2) the objective function — the scalar quantity to be extremized; (3) the constraint set — equalities and inequalities restricting feasible solutions (unconstrained optimization is the special case where the feasible region is the whole space); (4) the solution procedure — an algorithm or calculus method (gradient descent, Newton's method, linear programming) that navigates the decision space toward an optimum. It persists through mathematical notation and theorems (convexity, KKT conditions, duality), computational implementations in numerical libraries, and institutionalized practice across operations research, engineering, economics, and machine learning. Without the formal pairing of objective function and constraint structure, optimization degenerates into preference or trial-and-error, losing the guarantees (existence, optimality, convergence) that define it. replacement_spec.body: Audio compression is a human-made codec technique that reduces the size of audio data while preserving acceptable playback quality, typically via perceptual encoding, lossless encoding, or lossy transform coding. Parameters: codec family (e.g., MP3, AAC, Opus, FLAC), bitrate or quality setting, encoding mode (constant/variable bitrate), psychoacoustic model parameters, and container format. Mechanism: the audio signal is analyzed spectrally, perceptual masking thresholds are estimated, and quantization plus entropy coding discard information deemed inaudible, producing a smaller bitstream that can be decoded back to audio. Persistence: implemented in software encoders/decoders, streaming services, broadcast chains, and standardized specifications (ISO/IEC, ITU). Duplicate-merger correction, not a sense dispute: the pinned senses of both definitions agree.

The entry equivocates between two senses: its scope carves a MUSICAL phrase ('a discrete unit of musical meaning... notation, performance practice, and musicological analysis') while its accepted definition carves a LINGUISTIC phrase ('a group of words forming a single unit of meaning within a larger syntactic structure... head word that determines its syntactic category'). A reader of the scope alone would file edges against the musical sense; a judge applying Law 11d would apply the definition. The definition is the authoritative carve and the incident edges confirm it: phrase DEPENDS_ON syntax, SERVES communication, INSTANCE_OF expression — all linguistic senses; no musical edge (no relation to melody, meter, or musical notation) has been drawn to it. This REPLACE resolves the equivocation in favor of the definition: the scope is corrected to match the carved sense, the definition body is carried over unchanged, and the target's edges re-point to the successor. If the musical phrase was ever intended as a construct of its own, it belongs in its own entry — not as the scope of the linguistic one.

replacement_spec.definitionBody: Phrase is the human-constructed concept of a group of words forming a single unit of meaning within a larger syntactic structure. It is bounded by syntactic boundaries (not necessarily sentence boundaries), carries coherent semantic content, and functions as a building block of both spoken and written language. The concept persists through language use, grammatical teaching, and linguistic analysis — it is the unit by which speakers chunk linguistic output into processable segments for both production and comprehension. Parameters: a phrase has an internal head word that determines its syntactic category (noun phrase, verb phrase, prepositional phrase, etc.), and it must be structurally coherent even if elliptical. [formal: phrase | substrate: behavior | horizon: a moment | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]
replacement_spec.scopeJustification: A human-made analytical concept of language — a discrete unit of linguistic meaning: a group of words forming a single unit of meaning within a larger syntactic structure, persisting through language use, grammatical teaching, and linguistic analysis.
